label: Evidence-17
title: Siemens joins the CVE records as an affected supplier (RUGGEDCOM APE1808, SSA-566512); NVD now lists Palo Alto PAN-OS and the Siemens device among 306 vulnerable configurations
description: Both CVE records gained a Siemens supplier container on 23 October (14:07 UTC); NVD's configurations grew from four PHP ranges to 306 matches, including hundreds of PAN-OS versions (Palo Alto's own advisory is already in the vault, paloalto-psirt-cve-2026-109618). The first appliance vendors in the primary record. Capture Siemens SSA-566512; the inventory and affected pages are the owners'.
